LanguageData.MV_DisableAutoHomeAreaTooltip: Disable automatically expanding the Home area.
LanguageData.MV_EnableAutoRebuildInHomeAreaTooltip: Automatically rebuild buildings in the Home area which get destroyed.
LanguageData.MV_StartingAreasListTooltip: Comma separated list of areas to start a new game with (e.g., "Ship, Ship+, Work, Inside, Safe, Clean, Slaughter"). Enter up to 10 areas, or leave field blank to use RimwWorld's default of "Area 1." If you area using a mod like Areas Unlimted or TD Enhancement Pack's unlimited areas option, enter as many areas as you would like.
